manufacturer: FCI (now Amphenol ICC / Amphenol Communications Solutions)
notes: GENUINE FCI catalog 'MINITEK 127', 44 pp, InDesign, created 2009-11-26; '20021212' in the text layer (pymupdf) on pp.2, 16, 40. Pp.16-17 are the 20021212 RIGHT ANGLE THROUGH HOLE SHROUDED HEADER: part-number key 20021212-000<positions>T<plating>LF (positions 06..A0; plating 1 = gold flash), pitch and row 1.27, 0.40 square pin, insulator 5.30 x (2.99 + 1.27 x pins/2) +/-0.38, height 5.40, tail 2.30 below the body, tail rows 1.27 apart with the near row 1.20 behind the body face, recommended PCB layout 0.70 dia holes on 1.27 x 1.27, layout tolerance +/-0.05. Its MATING DATA (p.16) lists ONLY the board-to-board vertical receptacles 20021311 (p.21) and 20021321 (p.23); its shroud as drawn (p.17 top view) has NO centre key slot. Contrast p.33: the 20021512 right-angle IDC header carries a 2.40 key slot in the shroud wall, and p.26 lists the 20021444 IDC (ribbon) receptacle as mating only with the IDC and eject headers (20021511/512/521, 20021611/612/621). P.27: 20021444 has a centre key 2.00 wide standing 0.76 proud of a 3.00 body. P.21: 20021311 is a plain 3.00-deep rectangular body with no polarising feature. Text layer carries the prose and mating tables; drawing callouts are vector text too (read at 600 dpi). A 2009 catalog, NOT the controlled product drawing - see the BLOCKED row for 20021212.pdf
